items.title: Scholarships and Educational Exchanges for Development – Phase 2 (SEED-2)

requirements: Citizenship of an eligible ASEAN Member State, Pacific Island Country, or Mongolia
Full-time enrollment at a post-secondary institution in an eligible country
Paying tuition fees to home institution at application and during exchange
Must not hold or have a pending application for Canadian citizenship or permanent residency
Must not be participating in another Government of Canada-funded scholarship program
Must not be enrolled in a degree, diploma, or certificate program at a Canadian institution
Must not have previously received a Canada-ASEAN SEED scholarship
Application must be submitted by a Canadian Designated Learning Institution (DLI) on the student's behalf
Upload required supporting documents (under 5 MB in accepted formats)
info.funding_details: $10,200 for 4 months or $12,700 for 5-6 months for graduate students (Masters and PhD); covers visa/permit fees, airfare, health insurance, living expenses, ground transportation, and books/supplies, alongside mandatory tuition fee waiver by the Canadian institution.
info.deadline_note: The application deadline for 2026-27 was March 24, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. EDT, and the application period is closed.
info.eligible_fields: Areas that contribute to the implementation of the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development (Sustainable Development Goals / SDGs)
info.who_can_apply: Full-time enrolled students paying tuition at post-secondary institutions who are citizens of ASEAN Member States, Pacific Island Countries, or Mongolia; cannot hold/have pending Canadian citizenship or permanent residency, nor already be enrolled in Canada.
info.fit_reason: Morocco is not an eligible country, as the scholarship is strictly limited to citizens of ASEAN Member States, Pacific Island Countries, and Mongolia.
info.how_to_apply: Canadian partner post-secondary institutions must apply on behalf of eligible candidates via the My EduCanada online portal.
info.summary: The SEED-2 program provides short-term study or research exchange scholarships of up to $12,700 in Canada for post-secondary students from ASEAN, Pacific Island Countries, and Mongolia.
